facts.fact: Local government officers are to enter entity data, including physical addresses and beneficial ownership, directly into the national Non-Individual Register, on a Uganda Registration Services Bureau principal registration officer's word at Jinja on 7 May 2026; the system was then in final testing with full rollout expected by June 2026, and the document does not say from which office or over what connection.

systems.platform: centralised digital register issuing an Entity Registration Number (ERN)
systems.tiers: national repository; local government officers are to enter entity data into it; in final testing at May 2026, full rollout expected by June 2026

note: The one fact is a stated intention, not a live use: the register was still in testing, and the document names neither the local governments' offices nor their connection.
